_comment: Shared entity-identity vectors (#3590, Slice 0). One vector file consumed by tests/test_rebuild_live_invariant.py and tests/identity_vectors.py, per the #3589 shared-fixture mechanism (in-repo precedent: tests/fixtures/org_naming_vectors.json, #2779). Vectors are NOT inline test bodies: a vector with "harness": true is driven through the live SDK and asserted against the `rebuild == live` + empty-non-folded-set invariant (R8/R9) on every apply-based engine; "harness": false marks a shape that needs a later slice's mechanism (or a dedicated non-harness test). verdict is one of pass (green at S0), xfail (known-bad today; strict xfail with an owner), pending (no executable test yet — owner required). An xfail/pending vector without an owner is a permanently-skipped test with no owner, which #3589 forbids.

vectors.description: Two create_object calls for one name are idempotent (the #452 dedup contract) and replay identically.
vectors.expect_replay: the same one Object node, byte-identical
the same one Subject node, byte-identical

vectors.description: An Event whose aboutObject is the Object's id must resolve the edge on live AND replay.
vectors.expect_replay: the same Event, Object and edge — TODAY the edge is live-only

vectors.description: An Event whose aboutSubject is a bare name must resolve the edge on live AND replay.
vectors.expect_replay: the same Event, Subject and edge — TODAY the edge is live-only

vectors.description: Deleting an Object must not resurrect on replay. TODAY _delete_entity is a bare DETACH DELETE and the journal has no delete event, so the node vanishes live and comes back on rebuild.
vectors.expect_replay: the Object resurrected from its ObjectRegistered line

vectors.description: Delete then re-create must not replay the first incarnation. TODAY it does: the second ObjectRegistered replays first-wins on createdAt.
vectors.expect_live: one Object node carrying the SECOND registration's createdAt
vectors.expect_replay: one Object node carrying the FIRST registration's createdAt

vectors.description: A rename must survive replay. TODAY update_entity(name=...) mutates the live node only and journals no Renamed line, so replay restores the old name.

A bare-name EventRecorded reference must be replay-deterministic (D9). S0 pinned this xfail because the projection minted a random-ULID stub live and a DIFFERENT random ULID on replay; #3590 S1 keys the stub on the canonical entity key (_entity_key), so live and replay mint the SAME ids and the vector PASSES. S2 owns the other half of D9 (producers must register what they reference, and a projection-side reference to an unregistered name must refuse) and must re-derive this shape when it lands — the refusal becomes a non-folded entry and this all-green vector no longer describes it.
vectors.expect_live: Event + stubbed Subject/Object under their canonical entity keys
vectors.expect_replay: the SAME ids (deterministic key, not a random ulid)

vectors.description: A deleted entity and a never-created name must not compare equal. TODAY live-after-delete materialises nothing and a never-created name materialises nothing, so {} == {} — the distinction only exists once deletion is a tombstone (S2).
steps: verify the tombstone differs from an empty graph
vectors.expect_live: after S2: a status='retracted' tombstone, distinct from no node at all
vectors.expect_replay: same tombstone on replay, still distinct from the never-created side

vectors.description: The #3573 P1-A shape: an id-keyed reference and a name-keyed reference to the same supposed entity land on two nodes. Must not exist after S2; the explicit-id channel the vector needs is S2's.
steps: create_object with an explicit connector id
create_object by name with no id
vectors.expect_live: one node (the id and the name refer to one entity)
vectors.expect_replay: replay must reproduce exactly that one node

vectors.description: R5: re-registering a journaled-deleted id must fail closed on live (IdReuseError) and record a non-folded id-reuse entry on replay. The enforcement lands in S2.
steps: ObjectRegistered(cid) again via an explicit-id channel

vectors.description: D2 live-holder predicate: one live + one superseded holder is NOT ambiguous; a reference resolves to the live one. Needs the S1/S2 resolver.
vectors.expect_live: the live id, never the terminal one

vectors.description: D2: a name whose only holder is terminal must be REFUSED on a reference surface, never returned as a live id.
D2: status IS NULL AND outdated=true must be treated as DEAD. The vector fails if the predicate is reverted to the hand-rolled `status IS NULL OR NOT (status IN ...)` literal.
steps: create an entity with status=NULL, outdated=true

vectors.description: An event type with no dispatch branch is recorded as a shape='unhandled-event-type' non-fold naming its journal position (S0), and must fail the run on every engine (S2). Covered by the dedicated non-harness tests test_unknown_event_type_is_recorded / test_unknown_event_type_fails_the_run_on_replay.
steps: append an ObjectRegistered line plus a NoSuchEventType line to the journal
vectors.expect_live: nothing to see (the line is journal-only)
